turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Hale. Was Owen heard before you entered that zero?
Thanks for coming in, Ms. Kalinowski. I know your schedule is brutal.
My schedule isn't your concern. Was he heard first, yes or no?
I have to say, you're far more reasonable than I expected. Most parents come in swinging.
Don't. What do you actually have on his essay?
It's refreshing. You clearly see the whole picture, so I think we're really on the same side here.
The same side. Then show me something with a date on it.
